0.heading: Overview
refs: Psa 131:3 , exhorts Israel to trust in God.
Some think that this Psalm was composed by David when accused by Saul and his courtiers that he affected the crown
though others refer it to the time of the captivity
and consider it as containing a fair account of the manner in which the captives behaved themselves.
0.body:
Psa 131:1 , David, professing his humility
Psa 131:3 , exhorts Israel to trust in God.
Some think that this Psalm was composed by David when accused by Saul and his courtiers that he affected the crown; though others refer it to the time of the captivity; and consider it as containing a fair account of the manner in which the captives behaved themselves.
